offers_products.reason: Sells MiVIP identity verification platform, Digital Fraud Defender and MiPass software via SaaS, API and SDK.

offers_services.reason: Professional services for designing identity journeys exist but are secondary to the software platform.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are banks, building societies and platforms like Turo; end users are verified but businesses choose.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Over 7,000 organizations, including ABN AMRO and Nationwide Building Society, buy identity verification and fraud tools.

recurring_revenue.reason: Identity verification and authentication platform is SaaS, with ongoing per-use and subscription revenue across customer lifecycles.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fraud defense and regulatory compliance (KYC, AML) spend is hard to cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Sold as subscriptions and per-transaction verification, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for software and AI technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers include large banks like ABN AMRO and Nationwide; financial institutions are the core market.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and cloud platform business needs no heavy plants, fleets or properties.
